statements.text: It renders a nav landmark named by label, default "Breadcrumb"; set a distinct label when a page has more than one trail.

examples.html: <violet-breadcrumb aria-label="Crop plan path" label="Crop plan path"><violet-breadcrumb-item href="/plans" role="listitem">Plans</violet-breadcrumb-item><violet-breadcrumb-item href="/plans/propagation" role="listitem">Propagation</violet-breadcrumb-item><violet-breadcrumb-item aria-current="page" current href role="listitem">Spring greens</violet-breadcrumb-item></violet-breadcrumb>

summary: Navigation landmark that lays out violet-breadcrumb-item children as a trail ending at the current page.

usage.text: The last item is marked current automatically; if items set current, the last of those wins and the others are cleared. This runs when items are added or removed, not when current changes later.
